tips.too_small: Use the full camera resolution and move a little closer.
tips.blurry: Hold the phone steady and tap the leaf on screen to focus before taking the photo.
tips.too_dark: Take the photo in daylight, not at night or in deep shade.
tips.too_bright: Avoid harsh direct sun or flash glare. Shade the leaf with your body.

tips.unfamiliar_image: Check that the right crop is selected, then photograph a single leaf of that crop.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.stored: For each checkup: the leaf photo (made smaller, with hidden camera data such as GPS removed), the diagnosis and advice, the heatmap, your answer to "Was this correct?", and a random ID for this browser. Your location only if you chose to share it.
privacy.public: Nothing that identifies you. The public map only shows how many disease reports came from an area of about 5 km², and only when at least 3 different browsers reported there. Your exact location, photos and checkups are never shown to anyone else.
privacy.location: Taken only after you agree: from your phone's location or, if that isn't available, from the location saved in the photo. You can stop sharing any time with "Change" on the Diagnose page. For the weather risk of potato and rice, a point rounded to about 5 km is sent to the free weather service Open-Meteo, with nothing that identifies you. For a PDF report, our server loads the map around that rounded area from OpenStreetMap.
privacy.delete: This removes every checkup made in this browser, with its photos, from our servers. It cannot be undone. Do it before clearing your browser data: after that we can no longer tell which checkups were yours.
privacy.failed: Could not delete your data. Please try again.
privacy.contextTitle: Weather and soil for a checkup
privacy.context: The first time you open a checkup that has a location, our server looks up the weather around the photo date (Open-Meteo, the same point rounded to about 5 km), the rainfall compared with normal and a modelled soil map (through Google Earth Engine, which is sent only the centre of a square of about 250 m around your point, never the exact location). The result is saved with the checkup, without coordinates. Soil Health Card values you type in are saved with that checkup only. "Delete my data" removes all of it.

how.sub: Detect, diagnose and treat your crops, one leaf at a time.
how.s1d: Take a clear photo of the affected leaf, or upload one.
how.s2d: Our model reads the leaf and names the likely disease, and how sure it is.
how.s3d: See what to spray, how much crop is at risk, and what to do next.

honest.intro: A blurry, dark or leafless photo gets "please retake". A photo that doesn't look like that crop gets "not sure", never a guessed disease.
honest.p1d: The photo is checked before it is diagnosed.
honest.p2d: A heatmap shows which part of the leaf decided the answer.
honest.p3d: Every crop's accuracy comes with its confidence interval.
honest.note: * tested more strictly (5-fold grouped cross-validation, no near-duplicate photo on both sides); the others on one random 15% test split. Not directly comparable.
